risks.title: Dependence on a single production site
risks.score_rationale: The risk is mentioned in the RISK FACTORS section, with strong language on potential operational impact. It is stable compared to the previous year. The Industrial category is critical for a living therapy player. Central position in the document.

risks.title: Intense competition in cell therapies
risks.score_rationale: Highly emphasized language on competitive pressure, with references to major global players. Risk increasing due to sector expansion. Positioned early in the risk factors. Major strategic category.

risks.title: Strict regulation of CTGTP in Singapore
risks.score_rationale: Text explicitly cites HPA, CTGTP Regulations and HSA regulations. Demanding and detailed language. Risk is stable but fundamental. High position in the document. Key category for the biotech sector.

risks.title: Dependence on key technology partnerships
risks.score_rationale: Specific references to licenses with ATPL and Puricell. Language indicating operational dependency. Risk is stable. Central Technology category for innovation. Notable position in definitions.

risks.title: Insufficient protection of intellectual property
risks.score_rationale: Explicit mention of risk regarding IP position and litigation. Concerned language. Risk increasing with portfolio expansion. Strategic category. Positioned in key factors.

risks.title: Cybersecurity of sensitive clinical data
risks.score_rationale: Dedicated section ITEM 16K on cybersecurity. Cautious but concerned language. Risk is new or reinforced. Category growing in importance. Late but specific position.

risks.title: Dependence on specialized single-source suppliers
risks.score_rationale: Implicit mention through critical supply chain for living therapies. Cautious language. Risk is stable. Key operational category. Positioned in logistics risks.

risks.title: Dependence on key researchers and clinicians
risks.score_rationale: References to collaborations with institutes such as CRIS, IMCB and NUH. Language highlighting value of academic partnerships. Risk is stable. Critical human category. Positioned in strategic agreements.
